summary: Learn practical AI governance, model lifecycle controls, and reporting tools. Build real artefacts and improve oversight in 5 days.
lede: AI data governance training helps professionals who build, approve, monitor, or audit AI systems manage data and model controls throughout their lifecycle. Participants learn to map dataset lineage, classify data, define ownership and approval workflows, document models, and plan drift, bias, and performance monitoring. They also develop practical governance artefacts, including model registers, approval checklists, monitoring scorecards, and vendor review plans.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who govern, build, approve, monitor, or audit AI-enabled systems and the data that supports them.
prerequisites: You should have working familiarity with data governance, analytics operations, or AI delivery workflows. Prior exposure to model development, data stewardship, privacy review, or risk and compliance processes will help, but coding is not required for completion. Advanced concepts are taught at the operational application level, with practical exercises focused on governance design, documentation, and monitoring rather than engineering production models.
